title: assistant camera tools: photos, recording, passport, red sign (manual until automated)

clauses.text: Taking a photo always asks, and the longest grant offered is Allow for 5 minutes.

steps.do: Ask the assistant to take a photo.
steps.expect: An approval card appears. The grant it offers is at most Allow for 5 minutes, and no option allows the rest of the session.

clauses.text: A red sign reads Camera in use by the assistant on every screen while the assistant uses the camera.

steps.do: While the assistant takes a photo or records, look at another screen (for example open another app).
steps.expect: The red sign Camera in use by the assistant shows on every screen while it works, and goes when it stops.

clauses.text: A recording stops at its time limit (30 seconds by default, at most 600) and can be stopped early.

steps.do: Ask the assistant for a 30 second recording, and then, on another one, ask it to stop early.
steps.expect: The first stops by itself after about 30 seconds. The second stops at once when asked.

clauses.text: A passport photo gives the photo, a sheet (PNG or PDF) and the rules used, each with its source or UNVERIFIED.

steps.do: Ask the assistant for a passport photo for a country, with a 4x6 sheet. Stand centred, because the frame is fixed.
steps.expect: The photo and sheet come back. The rules say where they come from or say UNVERIFIED.

clauses.text: Pictures and recordings are saved in the person's Pictures and Videos, and the chat gives only the paths.

steps.do: After a photo, read where the chat says it was saved.
steps.expect: A path in Pictures is given (Videos for a recording). No picture is pasted into the chat.

clauses.text: While the CAMERA app holds the camera, the assistant's tool says the camera is busy.

steps.do: Open the CAMERA app with its preview on, then ask the assistant for a photo.
steps.expect: The assistant says the camera is busy.
